mentions.name: Postcrest
mentions.description: A SaaS platform that lets users create virtual characters to generate, schedule, and post educational or entertaining content on social media platforms with consistent personas. Still a work in progress with basic features already working; it enables people with content ideas to become creators without appearing in front of the camera.
mentions.problem: Enables anyone with ideas for engaging content to become a content creator without having to appear in front of the camera.
mentions.audience: Anyone with ideas for engaging content who wants to become a content creator
mentions.source_excerpt: It is a SaaS that allows you to create virtual characters to create, schedule and post educational or entertaining content on social media platforms with consistent personas. It is still very much work in progress, but already has some basic features working.

evidence.value: It is a SaaS that allows you to create virtual characters to create, schedule and post educational or entertaining content on social media platforms with consistent personas. It is still very much work in progress, but already has some basic features working.
